reading: Summer fires across Wales this year have resulted in "catastrophic" impacts, according to researchers.
Researchers from Bangor University report that the actual scale of destruction is much larger than what people can see.
Extreme heat and very dry weather made landscapes like heathland and moorland highly vulnerable to fast-spreading blazes.
This led to one of the UK's worst fire seasons in recent memory.
One expert noted that many only see blackened plants, but the significant effects are actually hidden underground.
At Sychnant Pass, a rare ecosystem globally important for specialist plants and insects, suffered significant losses.
Specifically, 4,000 years of organic carbon from the top layer of earth were lost there in just days.
The loss of this essential organic matter contributes to climate change and makes the natural environment much weaker.
Bangor University's team is now taking samples at various sites before winter rains wash away what remains.
This research involves comparing burned land with nearby untouched areas to measure changes in carbon, nutrients, and erosion risk.
Dr. Kara Marsden emphasized that rapid onsite work was crucial to measure conditions while the fires' impacts were still fresh.
She explained that early green growth does not mean full recovery, as deeply rooted plants like bracken sprout quickly, but shallower-rooted plants are often completely gone.
Jones warned that without swift restoration and better preparation for future fires, much of this natural environment could be lost permanently.

vocabulary.definition: causing sudden, extreme harm or suffering to a large degree.
the size or extent of something, especially when very large.
very large, strong, and often destructive fires.
all the living things in a particular area and the way they affect each other and the environment.
carbon that comes from living or once-living organisms, important for healthy earth.
helps to cause or is one of the reasons for something.
the possibility of earth or rock being gradually worn away by natural forces like water or wind.
the act of returning something to its former or original condition.
in a way that lasts forever or for a very long time without changing.

entries.ja: 突然、極めて大きな害や苦痛をもたらすさま。
entries.ko: 갑작스럽고 극심한 해나 고통을 막대한 규모로 유발하는.
entries.zh-Hans: 造成巨大、突如其来的严重损害或痛苦。
entries.es: Que causa un daño o sufrimiento repentino y extremo en gran medida.
entries.pt-BR: Que causa dano ou sofrimento repentino e extremo em grande escala.

entries.ja: 物事の大きさや範囲。特に、規模が非常に大きい場合を指す。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 크기나 범위. 특히 그 규모가 매우 클 때를 이른다.
entries.zh-Hans: 事物的尺寸或范围，尤其指规模非常大时。
entries.es: El tamaño o la extensión de algo, especialmente cuando es muy grande.
entries.pt-BR: O tamanho ou a extensão de algo, especialmente quando é muito grande.

entries.ja: 非常に大きく、強く、しばしば破壊的な火事。
entries.ko: 매우 크고 강하며 종종 파괴적인 불.
entries.zh-Hans: 非常大、猛烈且通常具有破坏性的火灾。
entries.es: Incendios muy grandes, fuertes y a menudo destructivos.
entries.pt-BR: Incêndios muito grandes, fortes e muitas vezes destrutivos.

entries.ja: 簡単に害を受けたり、損傷したりしやすいこと。
entries.ko: 쉽게 해를 입거나 손상될 수 있는.
entries.zh-Hans: 容易受到伤害或损坏的。
entries.es: Que puede ser dañado o perjudicado fácilmente.
entries.pt-BR: Que pode ser facilmente prejudicado ou danificado.

entries.ja: 特定の地域のすべての生物と、それらが互いに、そして環境にどのように影響し合うかを示すもの。
entries.ko: 특정 지역의 모든 생물과 그들이 서로 그리고 환경에 영향을 미치는 방식.
entries.zh-Hans: 特定区域内所有生物以及它们彼此之间和对环境产生影响的方式。
entries.es: Todos los seres vivos en un área particular y la forma en que se afectan entre sí y al medio ambiente.
entries.pt-BR: Todos os seres vivos em uma área específica e a maneira como eles afetam uns aos otros e o meio ambiente.

entries.ja: 生きている、またはかつて生きていた生物に由来する炭素で、健康な土壌にとって重要である。
entries.ko: 살아있거나 한때 살았던 유기체에서 유래한 탄소로, 건강한 토양에 중요하다.
entries.zh-Hans: 来自生物或曾经是生物的碳，对健康的土壤很重要。
entries.es: Carbono que proviene de organismos vivos o que alguna vez estuvieron vivos, importante para un suelo sano.
entries.pt-BR: Carbono que vem de organismos vivos ou que já foram vivos, importante para um solo saudável.

entries.ja: 何かが起こる原因となるのを助けたり、その理由の一つとなる。
entries.ko: 어떤 것의 원인이 되거나 그 이유 중 하나가 되는 데 도움을 준다.
entries.zh-Hans: 有助于造成某事或成为其原因之一。
entries.es: Ayudar a causar algo o ser una de las razones de ello.
entries.pt-BR: Ajudar a causar algo ou ser uma das razões para isso.

entries.ja: 水や風のような自然の力によって、土や岩が徐々に浸食される可能性。
entries.ko: 물이나 바람과 같은 자연적인 힘에 의해 흙이나 바위가 점진적으로 침식될 가능성.
entries.zh-Hans: 土壤或岩石被水或风等自然力量逐渐磨损的可能性。
entries.es: La posibilidad de que la tierra o la roca se desgasten gradualmente por fuerzas naturales como el agua o el viento.
entries.pt-BR: A possibilidade de terra ou rocha serem gradualmente desgastadas por forças naturais como água ou vento.

entries.ja: 極めて重要であるか、または必要であること。
何かを以前の状態や元の状態に戻す行為。
entries.ko: 어떤 것을 이전 또는 원래 상태로 되돌리는 행위.
entries.zh-Hans: 将某物恢复到其先前或原始状态的行为。
entries.es: El acto de devolver algo a su condición anterior u original.
entries.pt-BR: O ato de retornar algo à sua condição anterior ou original.

entries.ja: 永遠に、または非常に長い間、変化せずに続く方法で。
entries.ko: 영원히 또는 매우 오랫동안 변하지 않고 지속되는 방식으로.
entries.zh-Hans: 以一种永远持续或持续很长时间而不改变的方式。
entries.es: De una manera que dura para siempre o por un tiempo muy largo sin cambiar.
entries.pt-BR: De uma forma que dura para sempre ou por muito tempo sem mudar.
